steps: Open the public entry page (/) and observe the craigslist wordmark, global search box, and region/category index.
Use the primary navigation (category index housing link and/or region index Toronto link) to reach the housing section.
Verify the destination heading (housing) and canonical path (/toronto/housing/) are visible.
Verify the housing subcategory list includes sublets & temporary.
Start at the public entry and open the create-a-posting wizard.
Sign in with the seeded poster account when prompted (or register first).
Choose category housing > sublets & temporary and location Toronto > Annex.
Enter title '1BR near Annex - furnished sublet Jul-Aug', price 2400, postal code, attributes: 1 bedroom, furnished, available July 1, 2026 through August 31, 2026.
Enter contact email and description stating one-bedroom near Toronto Annex, $2400/month, July-August, furnished.
Optionally upload one photo, preview the post, and publish.
Confirm the resulting detail view visibly matches every condition: one-bedroom, near Annex, $2400/month, July-August, furnished.
Confirm the listing appears in the sublets category listing and in housing search results for the same price/neighborhood filters.
Browse classifieds by location (region page) and by category (housing subcategories).
Run a search from the housing search box with a free-text query.
Verify results render from the seeded data with titles, prices, locations, dates, and thumbnails.
Refine a housing search using price (min/max), neighborhood (postal/area), posting date (posted today), and category-specific filters (bedrooms, housing type).
Verify each filter narrows the seeded result set deterministically and the filter values remain visible in the filter bar.
Verify sorting by newest and by price and grid/list views.
Open a listing from search or category results.
Inspect description, photos, price, location, and reply/contact options.
Verify the post id, posted date, posted-by owner/dealer, map area, and avoid-scams guidance are present.
Verify the reply button opens the contact flow.
From a listing detail page open the reply/contact flow.
Submit the anonymous reply form with name, email, and message.
Verify inline validation when required fields are missing.
Verify the sent confirmation and that the message reaches the poster's local outbox without exposing a real address.
Open a listing and bookmark/favorite it.
Verify an anonymous actor receives the sign-in prompt.
Verify a signed-in actor's favorite persists across refresh and re-login and appears in the account saved page.
From a housing search, save the search.
Verify an anonymous actor receives the sign-in prompt.
Verify a signed-in actor's saved search persists and appears in the account searches page.
Open the sign-in entry.
Verify the email (username) field and the password and identity-provider choices are present.
Return without submitting credentials.
Open the account-registration entry.
Verify the visible identity fields (email, password, confirm password), terms links, and verification guidance.
Do not create an account.
From the sign-in surface open password recovery.
Verify the reset-address (email) field and validation guidance.
Verify the return-to-sign-in link.
Do not send a reset message.
Register a new account with a synthetic email and a valid password.
Verify the five-minute per-email registration rate limit on a second immediate attempt.
Log in with the new credentials and verify the session persists across refresh.
Log out and verify the session is gone and stateful pages require sign-in again.
With seeded offline data present, open the account history for housing records and actions.
Verify the newest item exposes its status (active), a detail link, edit/renew/repost/delete or cancellation options.
Verify a route back to the relevant collection (housing section or the posting itself).
Create a new classified post in a chosen category (housing > sublets) and location (Toronto > Annex).
Walk the wizard steps: category, location, details, contact, photos, preview, publish.
Verify each step validates and persists server-side state as the wizard advances.
Enter title, price, description, attributes (housing type, bedrooms, baths, square feet, available date, laundry, parking, AC), contact method, and map/location (postal code + neighborhood).
Verify inline validation for missing title, invalid price, and missing description.
Verify the map/location render is local and deterministic.
In the photos step upload multiple images.
Reorder them and verify the order persists into the preview and detail page.
Remove an image and verify it disappears from the preview.
Preview the post and verify it renders as the future detail page.
Reach the publish/confirmation step and verify the confirmation names the posting id and offers view/edit/delete.
Open an existing posting of the signed-in user.
Edit it and verify the change is visible on the detail page after saving.
Renew it and verify the posted date bumps.
Repost it and verify a new posting id is created.
Delete it and verify the detail URL renders the removed state and the listing leaves search results.
Verify a non-owner or anonymous actor gets a permission prompt on every mutation.
Open the reporting/flagging control for a listing.
Pick a reason, optionally add a note, and submit.
Verify the sent confirmation and that no private account data is exposed.
Search housing for the impossible query zzzz-no-match-websitebench (or apply an impossible public filter when discovery is browse-only).
Verify a no-results message is shown.
Verify a route back to available housing records and actions (return to search / housing section) works.
Open a stateful action (posting wizard, favorite, save search) while signed out.
Verify a permission prompt identifies that sign-in is required before continuation.
Open a mutation form with required fields empty (posting details, reply, contact, register).
Verify inline validation identifies what must be corrected before continuation and persists nothing.
Open the public help/support/contact entry from the footer.
Verify a user can reach guidance for housing records and actions, account access, and failed actions.
Verify no private account data is exposed anywhere on the help surface.
Open a non-existent deep link (for example /toronto/housing/d/999999999/does-not-exist).
Verify a branded not-found or recovery view preserves primary navigation.
Verify a safe route back to housing records and actions works.
